title: A hybrid FEM-PINN method for time-dependent partial differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2409.02810v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we present a hybrid numerical method for solving evolution partial differential equations (PDEs) by merging the time finite element method with deep neural networks. In contrast to the conventional deep learning-based formulation where the neural network is defined on a spatiotemporal domain, our methodology utilizes finite element basis functions in the time direction where the space-dependent coefficients are defined as the output of a neural network. We then apply the Galerkin or collocation projection in the time direction to obtain a system of PDEs for the space-dependent coefficients which is approximated in the framework of PINN. The advantages of such a hybrid formulation are twofold: statistical errors are avoided for the integral in the time direction, and the neural network's output can be regarded as a set of reduced spatial basis functions. translated_title: 一种求解时间相关偏微分方程的有限元-物理信息神经网络（FEM-PINN）混合方法
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种将时间有限元方法与深度神经网络相融合的混合数值方法，用于求解演化型偏微分方程（PDEs）。与传统的深度学习公式化方法（即神经网络直接定义在时空域上）不同，我们的方法在时间方向上采用有限元基函数，而空间相关的系数则被定义为神经网络的输出。随后，我们在时间方向上应用Galerkin投影或配点投影，得到一组关于空间相关系数的偏微分方程，并在PINN框架下对其进行近似。这种混合公式化的优势有二：其一，避免了时间方向积分中的统计误差；其二，神经网络的输出可以被视为一组降阶的空间基函数。为进一步缓解高维性带来的困难……（摘要原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将时间有限元方法与PINN结合的混合方法，在时间方向使用有限元基函数、以神经网络输出作为空间相关系数，从而避免时间积分的统计误差并获得降阶空间基函数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid FEM-PINN method that uses finite element basis functions in the time direction with neural network outputs as space-dependent coefficients, avoiding statistical errors in time integration and yielding reduced spatial basis functions for solving evolution PDEs.
